[spoiler=[b]battle of Aduab - day 5-7[/b]]
By Day 5, THEP forces cut off the island from the rest of the Sal-Baliz forces - The bridges that led directly into the island were blown up by the Sal-Baliz, in an attempt to force THEP forces to cross the river and attack the medieval walls that protected the island for so long. The coalition deployed artillery and sent bridge layers to help in the crossing of the river. No attack followed for the rest of Day 5, however. When night arrived, the Sal-Baliz defenders were woken up by the rotors of helicopters - Dozens of transport helicopters, supported by artillery and close air support, deployed special forces in key points in the Sal-Baliz defenses, such as police stations, apartments and vital highways. The ground forces advanced into the city around the same time as the special forces, the bridge layers using the cover of the night to open a path undisturbed. Sporadic and intense fighting ensued in the island, with all Sal-Baliz forces pushed back to the mosque and the citadel by the morning of Day 7. THEP forces split, Hydronia laid siege to the citadel, while the Bobians attacked the mosque.
[/spoiler]
